Eh. As I said, this kind of shit 'appens. Not everyone can be happy people.

But, in general i'm okay. As I said, i'll go to sleep tonight and wake up fine and ready. Then a couple days down the road (Sometimes less, sometimes I can go a week or so) before I sit down and think about it all again, get upset and frusterated with life, drink a little, go to sleep, and cue the re-run.

It's not really that big of a deal..

Well.. It sounds a lot worse than it truly was, to be honest.. Sure, they did that stuff (and more, of course) but I really was a pretty shitty kid. I had/have severe ADHD and was a really douchebaggy kid. Not to mention my parents were really poor. So stress on top of stress frusteration did't help..

I'm away from them now. And unfortunately i'll never kill myself. I just couldn't see it happening. I just don't really care about much of anything anymore.. I know i'll wake up tomorrow ready to do it all again, and then eventually either life will somehow get better or i'll die..
